title: Member of Parliament monthly base salary
definition: Official monthly base salary payable to a Member of Parliament under the Salary, Allowances and Pension of Members of Parliament Act, 1954, excluding constituency allowance (Rs 87,000/month), office expense allowance (Rs 75,000/month), and session daily allowance (Rs 2,500/day).

sources.publisher: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs, Government of India (via Press Information Bureau)
sources.title: Year End Review 2025: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs — Revision in Salary, Allowances and Pensions of MPs

points.evidence: Section 18 table (prior rate before 01.04.2023 revision): Salary 1,00,000/- per mensem.
Section 18 table (revised w.e.f. 01.04.2023 on Cost Inflation Index): Salary 1,24,000/- per mensem.
